title: Year in Code: Git Year in Review
description: Your coding year, wrapped: commits, streaks, languages, busiest hours and your coder type, from your local git history. Share it as an image. No account, no token.

title: Khmer Lint
description: Khmer for VS Code: spellcheck with word segmentation in any document, the Khmer NiDA keyboard (typing mode and on-screen keyboard), visible zero-width spaces, and Khmer fonts for other extensions.

title: Khmer Lint MCP
description: The Khmer Lint MCP server for AI agents: Khmer spellcheck, word segmentation, zero-width fixes and NiDA keyboard conversions in agent mode. Also installs the server in Claude Code, Claude Desktop and Cursor.

title: Open Lyric
description: Write songs in Open Lyric notation (*.ol.md): syntax highlighting, validation, snippets, and a live lyric/markdown preview.

title: Open Lyric MCP
description: The Open Lyric MCP server for AI agents: validate, transpose, edit, render and export Open Lyric songs from agent mode. Also installs the server in Claude Code, Claude Desktop and Cursor.

title: Open Lyric Khmer
description: Khmer for Open Lyric songs (*.ol.md): brings Khmer Lint's spellcheck and Khmer fonts to Open Lyric documents and their preview, plus Khmer example songs. Installs Open Lyric and Khmer Lint.

title: GitLite — Inline Blame & File History
description: Lightweight GitLens alternative. Inline blame, file history timeline, and simple diff viewer — fast, local, no bloat. Your code never leaves your machine.

title: YouTube Transcript to Text & Markdown
description: Get the transcript of any YouTube video as Markdown in VS Code, with or without timestamps, or insert it at the cursor. Uses your own Apify token.

title: Accenture Java Class Optimizer
description: Run the behavior-preserving Java refactoring skill from the Command Palette with Copilot Chat.
